profile: SmartRent provides an enterprise real estate management platform for property owners, managers, and residents. Its cloud-based software and connected hardware support smart apartments and homes, access control, community WiFi, asset monitoring, self-guided tours, work order management, leasing and resident call handling, audits, and inspections. The company also provides training, installation, and support services to multifamily and single-family rental owners, operators, homebuilders, and iBuyers.
